description: Search GravityPort visual memory using lexical search and explicit creation-time bounds. Multiple query words are combined with AND: every word must appear for an asset to match; OR is not supported. Returns compact per-asset summaries with the total match count (20 per page by default, at most 100; pass `cursor` to page further); use asset_get for an asset's full recipe and metadata.

createdAfter.description: Inclusive lower creation-time bound. A date-only value ("2026-11-07") means local midnight of that day on this machine; a value with Z or a ±hh:mm offset keeps its explicit zone.

createdBefore.description: Inclusive upper creation-time bound. A date-only value ("2026-11-07") means local midnight of that day, so the bound is "before Nov 7 starts" — assets created on Nov 7 itself are outside. A value with Z or a ±hh:mm offset keeps its explicit zone.

query.description: Space-separated words; every word must appear (AND). OR is not supported.

name: asset_search
